howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你配置、部署和管理 Firebase Hosting 静态网站、单页应用或简单微服务，包括设置重定向、预览频道等。
howto.when: 当你需要部署静态网站、单页应用或简单微服务，并希望使用 Firebase Hosting 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Firebase Hosting 部署一个 React 单页应用。
为我的网站创建一个预览频道来测试新版本。
say.note: Claude 会说明如何创建和使用预览 URL。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you configure, deploy, and manage Firebase Hosting for static sites, SPAs, or simple microservices, including setting up redirects and preview channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to deploy static websites, single-page apps, or simple microservices using Firebase Hosting.

say_en.text: Help me deploy a React single-page app using Firebase Hosting.
Create a preview channel for my site to test new changes.
say_en.note: Claude will explain how to create and use a preview URL.
